source.name: RSK Group: 'RSK Group and Charlton Athletic renew partnership for 2026-27 season'
source.quote: RSK has announced that it will continue as the club’s principal sustainability partner and front-of-shirt sponsor for the 2026–2027 season, extending its support across the men’s, women’s and academy teams.

source.name: SportsMint Media: 'Charlton Athletic FC bring in TodayTix as official experience partner for two years'
source.quote: The TodayTix logo will appear on the back of the men’s and women’s first team shirts throughout the two-year pact
source.note: Club announcement (cafc.co.uk, 30 Jun 2026) is behind an AWS WAF challenge for scripts; SportsMint reports the same deal. Two-year deal from June 2026.

source.name: The Guardian: 'Women's Super League 2026-27 preview No 5: Charlton Athletic'
source.quote: A record-breaking partnership has seen haircare brand Sofnfree become the women’s team’s official sleeve partner. The branding will feature on all playing and replica shirts
source.note: Club announcement 'Charlton Women announce record-breaking Sofnfree partnership' (cafc.co.uk, 19 Aug 2026) is behind an AWS WAF challenge for scripts; the Guardian confirms sleeve branding on all women's playing and replica shirts this season.

source.name: Footy Headlines: 'Charlton Athletic 26-27 Home Kit Released'
source.quote: Charlton Athletic’s 26-27 home kit, manufactured by Reebok,
source.note: The women's first team plays in the same 2026/27 Reebok home shirt (sold by the club shop as the WSL home shirt and worn by women's first-teamers in WSL matches).

summary: RSK Group, a UK engineering and environmental services group, fronts the Charlton Women shirt, with TodayTix on the back and haircare brand Sofnfree on the sleeve, on a shirt made by Reebok. No shorts sponsor found: London.Bet's back-of-shorts deal covers the men's first team only.
